series.name: Portable TCL AC (US/global — not PK retail line)
series.notes: Portable AC codes (acerrorcode + official US FT article). Not in PK retail AC lineup (MIRACLE/ELITE/T-PRO/etc.) — kept for completeness; portable P1 water-full ≠ split P1 voltage.

title.ur: Low temperature aur frost se protection

meaning.en: Portable unit blocks cooling to prevent freeze-up in cold room.
meaning.ur: Portable unit thande kamre mein cooling block karke freeze-up (brf) se bachata hai.

causes.ur: Kamra pehle se bohat sard ho
Frost sensor ki wajah se compressor band ho jata hai

solutions.en: Raise setpoint or switch mode — protection clears
solutions.ur: Setpoint barha dein ya mode badlein — protection khud clear ho jaye
Unit ko garam jagah par le jayein

source.title: acerrorcode.com portable TCL AC codes + official TCL US support article (FT)

notes.en: Portable-only; not sold in current PK line-up as per retailer recon. Per-code attribution: technician_site.
notes.ur: Yeh sirf portable model par hai; retailer ki maloomat ke mutabiq yeh abhi PK lineup mein nahi bikta. Har code ka source technician_site hai.

meaning.en: Temperature probe fault on portable unit.
meaning.ur: Portable unit ka temperature probe kharab hai.

solutions.en: Unplug the portable unit from the mains before touching the probe.
solutions.ur: Probe ko haath lagane se pehle portable unit ka plug socket se nikaal lein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the probe connector and check the element with a meter; a reconnected probe should read normally again.
solutions.ur: Probe ka connector dobara lagayein aur meter se element check karein; probe theek se lag jaye to reading normal aani chahiye.

solutions.en: Replace the probe/sensor if it stays open or short.
solutions.ur: Probe/sensor open ya short hi rahe to badlein.

source.title: acerrorcode.com portable TCL AC codes + official TCL US support article (FT)

notes.ur: Har code ka source technician_site hai.

title.ur: Tank bhar gaya (paani ki tank full)

meaning.en: Condensate tank full — unit stops dehumidifying/cooling until emptied.
meaning.ur: Condensate ki tank bhar gayi hai — unit dehumidifying/cooling band kar deta hai jab tak tank khali na ho.

causes.ur: Condensate jama ho kar tank bhar jaye

solutions.ur: Ho sake to continuous-drain hose lagayein

source.title: acerrorcode.com portable TCL AC codes + official TCL US support article (FT)

notes.en: Official: support.tcl.com full-tank-ft-error-code (US portable). Per-code attribution: official.
notes.ur: Official source: support.tcl.com ka full-tank-ft-error-code page (US portable). Har code ka source official hai.

title.ur: Kamre ke temperature sensor ki kharabi (portable)

meaning.en: Room-air sensor fault on portable AC.
meaning.ur: Portable AC ke kamre ke sensor ka fault hai.

causes.ur: Sensor open ya short ho jaye
Sensor tak ki wiring kharab ho jaye

solutions.en: Turn the unit off and unplug it before opening it.
solutions.ur: Kholne se pehle unit ko band kar ke plug nikalein.

solutions.en: Check the sensor resistance with a meter and inspect the wiring for damage; the reading should follow the temperature chart.
solutions.ur: Meter se sensor ka resistance check karein aur wiring damage ke liye dekhein; reading temperature chart ke mutabiq honi chahiye.

solutions.en: Replace the room sensor if it is open or short.
solutions.ur: Room sensor open ya short ho to badlein.

solutions.en: Replace the sensor if it is open or short.

title.ur: Portable ka pani tank fault, split wala voltage P1 nahi

meaning.en: On portable units P1 relates to water tank/sensor family; completely different from split inverter P1 (over/under voltage).
meaning.ur: Portable units par P1 paani ki tank/sensor se mutaalliq hai — split inverter P1 (over/under voltage) se bilkul alag.
